name: withered-unit-595f
description: Build a personal website, blog, or portfolio with Astro.

scripts.build:node: node scripts/check-blog-images.mjs && astro build --config astro.config.node.mjs && node scripts/check-blog-images.mjs dist/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run content:audit && npm test && npm run build
scripts.ci:pr: npm run typecheck && npm run content:audit && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.test: (find src -name '*.test.ts'; find scripts -name '*.test.mjs') | xargs env NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-loader ./scripts/ts-test-loader.mjs' node --test
scripts.test:ci: (find src -name '*.test.ts'; find scripts -name '*.test.mjs') | sort | xargs env NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-loader ./scripts/ts-test-loader.mjs' node --test --test-reporter=spec
scripts.test:coverage: find src -name '*.test.ts' -print | sort | xargs env NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-loader ./scripts/ts-test-loader.mjs' node --test --experimental-test-coverage
